title: The Dietary Window
transcript:
A paper cup slides through the hatch. One white pill, rattling.
On the other side of the counter a gloved hand waits. Blue nitrile. Patient.

WOMAN:
"Swallow."

He does. He always does.

WOMAN:
"Good."

The glove withdraws. A clipboard under the counter: a tick beside S-07.
A tick before it. A whole column of ticks before that.

It is a very small pill. It would fit under a tongue. It would fit in a pocket.
